```{r, warning=F, message=F}


library(clusterProfiler)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(msigdbr)
library(stringr)

source("../../00-constants.R")






# 8.1. Import data


rna_res <- read.csv(
  file.path(gene_results_dir, "DE_limma_results_transcriptome.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F
)

prot_res <- read.csv(
  file.path(prot_results_dir, "DA_results_proteomics.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F
)






# 8.2. Ranked genes list


# Use gene symbols and log2 fold changes
gsea_df <- rna_res %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(gene_symbol),
    gene_symbol != "",
    !is.na(log2FoldChange)
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    gene_symbol,
    .keep_all=T
  )

# Named numeric vector: log2FC, names = gene symbols
gene_ranks <- gsea_df$log2FoldChange
names(gene_ranks) <- gsea_df$gene_symbol

# Sort decreasing
gene_ranks <- sort(gene_ranks, decreasing=T)






# 8.3. Ranked proteins list


# Use protein gene symbols and log2 fold changes
protein_df <- prot_res %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(gene),
    gene != "",
    !is.na(log2FoldChange)
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    gene,
    .keep_all=T
  )

protein_ranks <- protein_df$log2FoldChange
names(protein_ranks) <- protein_df$gene

# Sort decreasing
protein_ranks <- sort(protein_ranks, decreasing=T)






# 8.3. RNA vs Protein dot plot


# Import Hallmark gene sets
hallmark_sets <- msigdbr::msigdbr(
  species="Homo sapiens",
  category="H"
) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gs_name,
    gene_symbol
  )

# Run GSEA for RNA
set.seed(project_seed)

gsea_hallmark_rna_all <- GSEA(
  geneList=gene_ranks,
  TERM2GENE=hallmark_sets,
  pvalueCutoff=1,
  eps=0,
  verbose=FALSE
)


# Run GSEA for protein
set.seed(project_seed)

gsea_hallmark_prot_all <- GSEA(
  geneList=protein_ranks,
  TERM2GENE=hallmark_sets,
  pvalueCutoff=1,
  eps=0,
  verbose=FALSE
)






# 8.3a. Compare RNA and protein Hallmark pathways


rna_df <- gsea_hallmark_rna_all@result %>%
  dplyr::select(
    ID,
    Description,
    NES_rna=NES,
    padj_rna=p.adjust
  )

prot_df <- gsea_hallmark_prot_all@result %>%
  dplyr::select(
    ID,
    NES_prot=NES,
    padj_prot=p.adjust
  )

hallmark_compare_df <- full_join(
  rna_df,
  prot_df,
  by="ID"
) %>%
  mutate(
    combined_abs_NES=abs(NES_rna) + abs(NES_prot)
  )


# Select top 20 pathways by combined absolute NES
hallmark_to_plot <- hallmark_compare_df %>%
  arrange(desc(combined_abs_NES)) %>%
  slice_head(n=20)






# 8.3b. Prepare plot content


plot_df <- hallmark_to_plot %>%
  dplyr::select(
    ID,
    Description,
    NES_rna,
    padj_rna,
    NES_prot,
    padj_prot,
    combined_abs_NES
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols=c(NES_rna, NES_prot),
    names_to="Omics",
    values_to="NES"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    padj=ifelse(Omics == "NES_rna", padj_rna, padj_prot),
    Omics=ifelse(Omics == "NES_rna", "RNA", "Protein"),
    Significant=padj < 0.05,
    Description=stringr::str_wrap(
      tools::toTitleCase(
        tolower(
          gsub(
            "_",
            " ",
            gsub("^HALLMARK_", "", Description)
          )
        )
      ),
      width=40
    ),
    Description=reorder(
      Description,
      combined_abs_NES
    )
  )


# Colors are defined in 00-constants.R
omics_colors <- c(
  "RNA"= gene_color,
  "Protein"= protein_color
)






# 8.3c. RNA vs. protein pathway dot plot


lolliplot <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    y=Description,
    x=NES
    )
  ) +

  # Center line
  geom_vline(
    xintercept=0,
    linewidth=0.5,
    color="grey60"
  ) +

  # Stems
  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x=0,
      xend=NES,
      yend=Description
    ),
    linewidth=0.55,
    color="grey75"
  ) +

  # Points: filled if significant, hollow if not significant
  geom_point(
    aes(
      fill=ifelse(Significant, Omics, "NotSig"),
      color=Omics
    ),
    shape=21,
    size=5.0,
    stroke=1.4
  ) +

  # Fill indicates pathway significance
  scale_fill_manual(
    values=c(
      "RNA"=gene_color,
      "Protein"=protein_color,
      "NotSig"="white"
    ),
    breaks=c(
      "RNA",
      "Protein",
      "NotSig"
    ),
    labels=c(
      "RNA",
      "Protein",
      "Not significant"
    ),
    name="",
    guide=guide_legend(
      override.aes=list(
        color=c(
          gene_color,
          protein_color,
          "grey60"
        ),
        stroke=1.4,
        shape=21
      )
    )
  ) +

  # Color identifies omics modality
  scale_color_manual(
    values=omics_colors,
    guide="none"
  ) +

  # Axes
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits=c(-2.5, 4.5)
  ) +

  # Labels and title
  labs(
    title="RNA vs protein pathway enrichment",
    x="Normalized Enrichment Score (NES)",
    y=NULL
  ) +

  # Theme
  theme_classic(
    base_family="Arial"
  ) +

  theme(
    text=element_text(
      family="Arial",
      size=16,
      face="plain"
    ),
    axis.text.y=element_text(
      family="Arial",
      size=14,
      face="plain",
      colour="black"
    ),
    axis.text.x=element_text(
      family="Arial",
      size=16,
      face="plain",
      colour="black"
    ),
    axis.title.x=element_text(
      family="Arial",
      size=16,
      face="plain",
      colour="black"
    ),
    axis.title.y=element_blank(),
    axis.line=element_line(
      colour="black",
      linewidth=0.5
    ),
    plot.title=element_text(
      family="Arial",
      size=16,
      face="plain",
      colour="black",
      hjust=0.5
    ),
    legend.position="bottom",
    legend.direction="horizontal",
    legend.justification="left",
    legend.box="vertical",
    legend.title=element_text(
      family="Arial",
      size=16,
      face="plain",
      colour="black"
    ),
    legend.text=element_text(
      family="Arial",
      size=16,
      face="plain",
      colour="black"
    ),
    legend.key.size=grid::unit(
      1.2,
      "lines"
    ),
    plot.margin=ggplot2::margin(
      10, 20, 10, 10
    ),
    panel.grid.major.x=element_line(
      color="grey92",
      linewidth=0.4
    )
  )


# Export as PDF
ggsave(
  filename=file.path(
  plots_dir, "(2C)_GSEA_Hallmark_RNA_vs_Protein.pdf"),
  plot=lolliplot,
  width=8,
  height=8,
  device=cairo_pdf,
  bg="white"
)


# Save plot object for patchwork
saveRDS(
  lolliplot,
  file.path(gene_results_dir, "figure2C.rds")
)






```
